Recent work supports separating gradient direction, magnitude, and sampling noise. CVPR 2025’s [ConsMTL](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Qin_Towards_Consistent_Multi-Task_Learning_Unlocking_the_Potential_of_Task-Specific_Parameters_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf) shows that task-specific parameters influence conflicts propagated into shared parameters; [PIVRG](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Qin_Revisiting_Fairness_in_Multitask_Learning_A_Performance-Driven_Approach_for_Variance_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf) explicitly addresses variance in gradient aggregation. Applied to the single BERT4Rec model, these motivate repeated, bounded reconstruction-versus-terminal measurements: per-objective norms, dot products, cosine similarities, and conflict frequencies, separately for embeddings and each encoder block. Report uncertainty across sampled batches; one negative cosine cannot establish persistent conflict.

Loss denominators are essential. Hugging Face’s October 2024 [gradient-accumulation correction](https://huggingface.co/blog/gradient_accumulation) demonstrates that averaging batch means differs from dividing summed losses by the total eligible-token count. Thus, 75% terminal examples does not imply 75% gradient contribution. Measure both unweighted objective gradients and gradients after the actual denominators and coefficients; verify their sum reproduces the implemented combined-loss gradient before clipping or optimizer updates.

A proposed diagnostic control is to compare same-batch cross-objective dot products with independently sampled cross-batch products: their difference estimates sampling covariance under matched sampling assumptions, while independent products estimate alignment of mean gradients. Repeat fixed batches with controlled dropout to isolate stochasticity. Bind every report to checkpoint and sampler hashes, objective coefficients, reduction rules, realized example/target counts, masking policy, RNG states, and model mode. Treat conflicting allocation snapshots as unresolved provenance, not evidence of training behavior. These are measurement recommendations, not findings about the supplied checkpoint.
